regions.today: Cloud breaking up this afternoon to give a very warm day with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 21 to 27 degrees, in light westerly or variable breezes. Sea fog may encroach onto coasts at times.
regions.tonight: Clear and dry tonight. Mild and humid overnight lows of 13 to 17 degrees in light northerly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Another very warm or hot day with plenty of sunshine, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 24 to 28 degrees, with light northerly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Mostly high. Occasionally moderate under cloudy skies.
